description.zh: 建议生成的日期。格式：yyyyMMdd（UTC时间）。
description.en: The date when the suggestion is generated. Specify the date in the yyyyMMdd format. The date must be in UTC.

description.zh:
集群ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~)接口查看数仓版集群的集群ID。
description.en:
The cluster ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region.

description.zh:
地域ID。
> 您可以通过[DescribeRegions](~~143074~~)查看可用的地域。
description.en:
The region ID of the cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
